name: manual_ba2f99
claim: When a new test guards behaviour that is already correct, fail-first is impossible; prove it instead with a mutation check: apply the exact regression the reviewer describes, confirm only that test fails, then restore the file and confirm the working tree matches what is staged.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: review nitpicks asked for tests of behaviour that was already correct (extra cannot override integrity fields; cmd_drop keeps a BOM). Such tests cannot fail on the pre-fix code, so each was proven by temporarily introducing the regression the reviewer described (merge extra last; decode with utf-8-sig) and seeing exactly that test fail.
